hints.tr: Tek sayıda `max_words`'te son kısım bir kelime fazla alır.
hints.en: With an odd `max_words` the tail gets one more word.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def fit_middle(text, max_words):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) <= max_words:
        return text
    head = max_words // 2
    tail = max_words - head
    return " ".join(words[:head]) + " ... " + " ".join(words[-tail:])


print(fit_middle("one two three four five six seven", 4))
print(fit_middle("short text", 4))
```

The full solution:

```python
def fit_middle(text, max_words):
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) <= max_words:
        return text
    head = max_words // 2
    tail = max_words - head
    return " ".join(words[:head]) + " ... " + " ".join(words[-tail:])


print(fit_middle("one two three four five six seven", 4))
print(fit_middle("short text", 4))
```
